messages.content: You write evaluation questions for an assistant that answers questions about Indian health-insurance rules issued by the regulator IRDAI. Questions must sound like a real policyholder, agent or claims officer asking. Never mention 'the passage', 'the circular above' or page numbers in a question. Answers are 1-3 plain sentences. Reply with JSON only.

Passage (from Annexure to IRDAI Master Circular on Health Insurance Business (29 May 2024) | page 11):
"""
Benefit Structure without pricing impact Others - Please Specify 1.8.4 Is the Product Modification filed for the first time? Yes/No 1.8.4.1 If YES, please furnish the date of first filing of the product. If No, please give furnish information in item no. 1.9 dd/mm/yyyy 1.8.4.2 Please give the proposed modifications in the following tabular form S.no Existing Features / assumption /premiums rates - which are proposed to modify Proposed modifications Justification for such modification Any supporting data for such modification 1.9 Please give complete history of modifications carried out till date in the following tabular format S No Date of modification Existing Features/ Assumptions/ premium rates as on date of clearance of the product i.e. before the modification Features/ Assumptions/ premium rates modified from the first/subsequent filing i.e. after the clearance of the modification Date of clearance of the modification from the PMC and the unique identification number allotted
"""

Write up to 2 different questions that this passage alone fully answers. Prefer concrete rules: time limits, amounts, conditions, who must do what. If the passage is only boilerplate, headings or a form, return {"items": []}.
JSON: {"items": [{"question": str, "answer": str, "facts": [2-4 short spans copied word-for-word from the passage that the answer needs]}]}

content: {"items":[{"question":"When must a product modification be filed for the first time and what information is required in the filing?","answer":"If a product modification is being filed for the first time, the insurer must indicate 'Yes' and provide the date of the first filing. The filing must also include a table of proposed modifications, justifications, and any supporting data.","facts":["1.8.4 Is the Product Modification filed for the first time? Yes/No","1.8.4.1 If YES, please furnish the date of first filing of the product."]},{"question":"What information must be recorded in the history of modifications table?","answer":"The history table must list each modification with its date, the existing features or rates before clearance, the features or rates after clearance, and the date of clearance along with the unique identification number assigned by the PMC.","facts":["1.9 Please give complete history of modifications carried out till date in the following tabular format","S No Date of modification Existing Features/ Assumptions/ premium rates as on date of clearance of the product i.e. before the modification Features/ Assumptions/ premium rates modified from the first/subsequent filing i.e. after the clearance of the modification Date of clearance of the modification from the PMC and the unique identification number allotted"]}]}
